title: 城市 · City
subject: a walled medieval CITY seen straight down from a survey aircraft, at its heart a cathedral with a tall spire and a guild hall beside a market square with striped awnings, the houses joined wall to wall into solid irregular blocks of terracotta roofs ringed by narrow crooked lanes, a river channel with two stone arch bridges and a water mill, quays with small boats, A BROKEN STRETCH OF OLD CITY WALL WITH TWO ROUND TOWERS STANDING ONLY ALONG ONE SIDE, suburbs and lanes spilling past it, the built area THINNING OUTWARD at its rim into scattered farmsteads, hedgerows, tree lines, orchards and strip fields that grow sparser and sparser until nothing is left, so it has no boundary of any kind, the buildings standing on NOTHING AT ALL, no ground slab, no soil, no grass, no earth under or around them, plain white showing between and beneath the outermost buildings
